pages.text: Welcome to Seeking Immortals. This guide will help you take your first steps from mortal to cultivator.$(br2)This mod focuses on $(l)mortal-style cultivation$(), emphasizing spiritual power management, lifespan pressure, root quality differences, and gradual realm breakthroughs.

pages.title: Step 1: Test Spiritual Root
pages.text: Use $(l)Spiritual Root Test Stone$() on yourself to check your root quality.$(br2)Spiritual roots determine cultivation speed and elemental technique power. Dual roots are better than triple roots, and single roots are excellent quality.$(br2)Special physiques (like Thunder Spirit Body, Ice Spirit Body) provide additional technique power bonuses.

pages.title: Step 2: Obtain Spiritual Power
pages.text: Cultivation requires $(l)spiritual power$().$(br2)Ways to obtain spiritual power:$(li)Right-click with a spirit stone to activate absorption$(li)Use Spirit Recovery Pills for quick restoration$(li)Meditate on a cushion in a high-aura environment or spirit gathering array$(li)Wear a Spirit Charm in a Curios slot$(br2)Maximum spiritual power increases with realm.

pages.title: Step 3: Meditate and Cultivate
pages.text: Right-click a $(l)Meditation Cushion$() and remain seated to begin breathing cultivation; no separate key binding is required.$(br2)Taking damage, moving, jumping, or leaving the cushion interrupts meditation. Aura, spiritual root, physique, method, and spirit stones determine the gain.$(br2)Open the $(l)Cultivation$() page from your inventory to inspect the gain per second and its factors.

pages.title: Step 4: Breakthrough Realm
pages.text: Use command $(l)/seeking_immortals breakthrough$() to attempt breakthrough.$(br2)Requirements:$(li)Sufficient cultivation experience$(li)Meet age requirement for the realm$(li)A suitable success rate (Jiangchen Pill and other matching breakthrough aids can help)$(br2)Failure causes experience loss; repeated failures may trigger qi deviation.

pages.title: Step 5: Learn Techniques
pages.text: Right-click a $(l)method manual or inheritance scroll$() to learn methods and techniques; the method tree only inspects and refines methods already learned.$(br2)Press the $(l)Technique Edit Key$() (bind it in Controls) to search learned techniques and configure 7 slots, then bind their release keys.$(br2)Techniques consume spiritual power and have cooldowns.

pages.title: Step 6: Resource Loop
pages.text: Cultivation requires many resources:$(li)$(l)Spirit Stones$(): Absorb spiritual power, trade currency$(li)$(l)Pills$(): Accelerate cultivation, aid breakthrough, restore status$(li)$(l)Talismans$(): One-time technique items$(li)$(l)Materials$(): Raw materials for alchemy, refining, talisman-making$(br2)Gather through harvesting, killing monsters, completing quests, or trading in markets.

pages.title: Next Steps
pages.text: After basic cultivation, you can:$(li)Join a sect for technique inheritance and resources$(li)Explore secret realms for treasures$(li)Learn alchemy, refining, talisman-making$(li)Participate in sect quests and faction wars$(br2)See other handbook chapters for detailed information.
